oracle_check.note: oracle.price() at the liquidation block. Quoted seized collateral is seized assets times that price divided by 1e36. The bonus is that quote minus repaid assets, in 6-decimal USDC. Not a DEX fill.

fork_test.other_attempt: https://base.drpc.org returned HTTP 429 while replaying the block. No second profit figure.
fork_test.note: USDC left in FlashLoanLiquidator after a zero-fee Morpho flash loan of 200 USDC, a full repay of borrow shares, and an Aerodrome volatile swap. The test asserts at least 1 USDC, not this exact amount. Measured once.

methodology.morpho_bonus: seized * daily Morpho USD price minus repaid * daily Morpho USD price. Not the oracle price at the block, except where the delay probe read oracle.price.
methodology.euler_bonus: bonusUsd from Euler Data API v3, source field kept per event.
methodology.delay: Archive eth_call. Morpho health includes Taylor interest and virtual shares. Euler uses vault.checkLiquidation. Lookback is 7 days.
methodology.sample: Morpho: up to 18 events per chain with daily-mark bonus >= $100, plus a seeded random fill to 36. Euler: every event in the window.
methodology.slippage_historical: Not reconstructed, except the one Aerodrome quote recorded in config/liquidation-fork.json.
methodology.flash_fee: Zero only if the latest Morpho Blue or Balancer V2 balance covers the repaid amount.
methodology.logs: Moonwell and Seamless on Base were scanned for about 2 days (blocks 52908363-52994763). The Fluid Base liquidator was scanned for about 14 days (blocks 52389963-52994763). Silo on Arbitrum was one contract for about 2 days (blocks 516917727-517608927). Not 90 days.
